fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
fields.schemeName: Flexible Memorandum of Understanding (Flexi-MoU) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is designed to cater to the needs of both industry as well as trainees. The scheme allows industries to train candidates as per their skill set requirements and provides trainees with an industry environment aligned with the market demand and latest technology to undergo training.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Coir Vikas Yojana- Export Market Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Coir Board is implementing the Central Sector Scheme “Export Market Promotion Scheme” with a view to improve the export performance of Indian Coir Sector through various export market promotion activities.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive Scheme Tranche-I under National Programme on High Efficiency Solar PV Modules
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the manufacturing of high-efficiency solar photovoltaic modules and reduce import dependence. Through this scheme, Production Linked Incentive is provided to eligible manufacturers.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme
fields.briefDescription: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme is an extensive drive to create awareness amongst MSMEs about Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) practices and motivate and incentivize them for ZED Cerficaon while also encouraging them to become MSME Champions.

fields.schemeName: VAIshwik BHArtiya Vaigyanik (VAIBHAV) Fellowship
fields.briefDescription:
VAIBHAV Fellowship envisages collaboration between scientists of Indian Diaspora with
Indian Higher Educational Institutions/Universities/Public Funded Scientific
Institutions. Fellow would identify an Indian Institution for collaboration &
may spend upto two months in a year for a max. of 3 years.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance for Administering Road Safety Advocacy and Awards for the Outstanding Work Done in the Field of Road Safety
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Scheme is to stimulate and encourage opportunities for various agencies through participation, in order to create awareness on road safety.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Intellectual Property Right Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Intellectual Property Right Scheme offers legal and intellectual property filing support including patents, trademarks, copyrights, designs, geographical indications (GI) etc.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
fields.briefDescription: Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme provides  reimbursement to an SC/ST Micro & small enterprises(MSEs), on annual membership subscription fee / one-time subscription charges/entry fee charged by various Export Promotion Councils (EPC).

fields.schemeName: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
fields.briefDescription: Through Idea Lab Scheme, AICTE will be setting up Idea Labs in AICTE approved institutions to encourage students for application of science, technology engineering and mathematics (STEM) fundamentals towards enhanced hands-on experience, learning by doing and even product visualization.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Setting Up of Plastic Parks
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase the competitiveness and value addition in the plastic processing industry through cluster development. It provides grant-in-aid up to ₹40,00,00,000/- for common infrastructure benefits intended for Special Purpose Vehicles and local enterprises.

fields.schemeName: Star College Scheme For Strengthening Of Science Education And Training At Undergraduate Level
fields.briefDescription: The Dept. of Biotechnology has launched "Star College Scheme for Strengthening of Science Education and Training at Undergraduate Level" for improving critical thinking and 'hands-on' experimental work at the undergraduate (college) level in sciences.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP) Interventions: Reimbursement of Energy and Water Audit Fees- DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote resource efficiency and sustainability among MSMEs by encouraging the adoption of energy and water-saving measures through professional audits. It provides financial assistance to cover part of the audit cost.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP) Interventions: Reimbursement of GST Amount for Promoting Destination Wedding- DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: This intervention promotes tourism in the Union Territory by incentivising destination weddings organised through local MSME service providers by reimbursing the GST component paid by clients.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: III. Scheme C4: For Food Processing Industries
fields.briefDescription: “Scheme For Food Processing Industries'' under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for Thrust Sectors, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide Interest Subsidy to the Establishment /Expansion of Food processing industries.

fields.schemeName: Supporting Community Radio Movement in India
fields.briefDescription: The GOI has a policy for grant of License to eligible organisations for setting up of Community Radio Stations. To support the Sector, the Scheme provides financial assistance once the Community Radio is made operational by eligible organisation. The Scheme also has components for capacity building.

fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components Industry
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers financial incentives to boost domestic manufacturing of Advanced Automotive Technology products and attract investments in the automotive manufacturing value chain.

fields.schemeName: Infrastructure and Technology Support
fields.briefDescription: The sub-scheme “Infrastructure and Technology Support” aims to develop world-class infrastructure in the country to support handicraft production, enhance product quality, and reduce costs to enable it to compete in the global market.

fields.schemeName: Advance Authorisation(AA)
fields.briefDescription: Advance Authorisation scheme enables duty free import of inputs for export production, including replenishment of inputs or duty remission Advance Authorisation covers manufacturer exporters or merchant exporters tied to supporting manufacturer(s).

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance For Development Of Buddhist/Tibetan Arts And Culture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Development of Buddhist/Tibetan Arts and Culture” was launched by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India to provide financial assistance to voluntary Buddhist/Tibetan organizations including Monasteries.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Swachhta Udyami Yojana – Swachhta Se Sampannta Ki Aur
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure mechanised cleaning and provide related safe and sustainable livelihood opportunities to Safai Karamcharis and liberated Manual Scavengers. The Financial assistance is provided for the procurement and operation of sanitation-related equipment and vehicles for the target.

fields.schemeName: Cultural Function And Production Grant Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme covers all ‘not-for-profit’ organizations, NGOs, Societies, Trusts, and Universities for supporting Seminars, Conference, Research, Workshops, Festivals, Exhibitions, Symposia, Drama-Theatre, Music, etc., and small research projects on different aspects of Indian Culture.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Credit Based Schemes For SC - Term Loan (TL)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for viable income-generating activities of Scheduled Caste beneficiaries. Through this scheme, term loans of up to 95% of the project cost are provided for projects costing up to ₹50,00,000/-.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP) Interventions: Reimbursement of Testing and Certification Cost in Wire Cable Industry- DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: This intervention aims to enhance the quality standards and global competitiveness of MSMEs in the Wire & Cable industry by supporting product testing and certification, thereby improving access to domestic and international markets.

fields.schemeName: Khelo India Scheme: Khelo India Centres and Sports Academies
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage sports across the country by strengthening sports infrastructure, coaching, talent development, and sports academies, thereby promoting excellence in sports and holistic development of children and youth.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation Of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 29th June 2020, PMFMPE is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme by the MoFPI, designed to address the challenges faced by the micro enterprises and to tap the potential of groups and cooperatives in supporting the upgradation and formalization of these enterprises.

fields.schemeName: Modernisation And Removal Of Obsolescence
fields.briefDescription: MODROB scheme, one of the AICTE Quality Improvement Scheme (AQIS), intends to support the development of laboratories with appropriate equipment/ technology/ tools/ software and encourages financial contribution from the industry.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Sub-mission On Agriculture Mechanization
fields.briefDescription: The Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization was launched in 2014-15 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare.

fields.schemeName: Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan)
fields.briefDescription: GOBARdhan Scheme was launched in April 2018 as a part of the Solid and Liquid Waste Management component under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) to positively impact village cleanliness and generate wealth and energy from cattle and organic waste. The main focus of GOBARDHAN is to keep villages clean.

fields.schemeName: Haritha Haram
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Haritha Haram program is to increase the green cover of the state from the existing 24% to 33% by planting and nurturing millions of saplings every year. The program also aims to create awareness among the public about the importance of preserving and protecting the environment.

fields.schemeName: The Meghalaya Victim Compensation Scheme, 2022
fields.briefDescription: The Meghalaya Victim Compensation Scheme, 2022 is a social welfare scheme introduced by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Meghalaya. Under this scheme, financial assistance to the victim along with support services such as shelter, counseling, medical aid, legal assistance, education, etc.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Introduced by the Department of Fisheries, Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is a scheme to bring about ecologically healthy, economically viable, and socially inclusive development of the fisheries sector of India.

fields.schemeName: CM’s Lairik Heiminnashi Programme (CMLH): Pre-Matric Remedial Coaching
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide handholding support in the form of remedial coaching to students studying in government academic institutions or institutions receiving grant-in-aid support from the Government, who belong to minority, OBC or SC communities of the State of Manipur.

fields.schemeName: Biponi Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to support to the Micro & Small enterprises to participate in different trade fairs and events within the State, in the Country and abroad for marketing of their products and also getting the exposure.

fields.schemeName: Acharya Vidyasagar Gau Samvardhan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to Increase in milk production, improving the economic status of the beneficiaries, increase in milk production capacity of animals and provide employment opportunities.

fields.schemeName: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Infrastructure & Technology Support: URBAN HAAT" is introduced is to set up a permanent marketing infrastructure in towns/ metropolitan cities to provide direct marketing facilities to handicrafts artisans/handloom weavers, enabling them to sell their products to wider target audience.

fields.schemeName: Himachal Pradesh Maharishi Valmiki Sampoorn Swachata Puraskar (state Sanitation Reward Scheme)
fields.briefDescription: The Maharishi Valmiki Sampoorn Swachata Puruskar (MVSSP) is a scheme under the Swachh Bharat Mission (G), Rural Development Department, H.P Government to identify and recognize the cleanest Gram Panchayat at various levels, including block, district, division, and state.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister’s Krishi Samuh Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh started the scheme “Chief Minister’s Krishi Samuh Yojana (CMKSY)” to empower the farmers through a cooperative approach by Institutionalisation of Farmers’ Producers’ Organisation and infusing timely support of good agriculture practices and marketing interventions.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yoiana 2017
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has decided to implement the Chief Minister's Adarsh Gram Yojana 2017 for creating model villages in the state.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister’s White Revolutions Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The CMWRS is a scheme aimed at boosting milk production and rejuvenating cooperative systems in five potential districts of Arunachal Pradesh. It targets 200 dairy farmers in a cooperative model to create subsistence means of livelihood for poor farmers and enhance organic agricultural productivity.

fields.schemeName: District Innovation And Challenge Fund
fields.briefDescription: The objectives of the "District Innovation and Challenge Fund (DICF)" are to Instill a sense of competitiveness amongst the Deputy Commissioners for developmental interventions, and to bring innovation in the design, planning, and implementation of critical infrastructure.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Awards For Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities: National Awards For Institutions Engaged In Empowering Persons With Disabilities: Divyangjano Ke Liye Sarvshrestha Niyoktha
fields.briefDescription:
The "Divyangjano Ke Liye Sarvshrestha Niyoktha" award is given by DoEPwD to the outstanding employers of the disabled under: 
1.  Government organization.
2.  Public Sector Undertaking or Autonomous Body or Local Government Body.
3.  Private or Non-Governmental Organization.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Awards For Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities: National Awards For Institutions Engaged In Empowering Persons With Disabilities: Divyangjanon Ke Sashaktikaran Men Karyrat Sarveshrestha Sansthan (Private Organization, NGO)
fields.briefDescription: The "Divangjano ke Shashaktikaran Mein Karyrat Sarveshrestha Sansthan" award is given by DoEPwD to an organization working for the empowerment of Persons with Disabilities for a minimum period of 10 years after registration under Society Act/ Trust Act / Section 8 of Companies Act 2013.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance For Cultural Activities In Performing Arts For Building Grants Including Studio Theatres
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Cultural Activities in Performing Arts for Building Grants Including Studio Theatres” was launched by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Grant-in-Aid Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance To The Mahila Mandals/ Women’s Self-help Groups (SWAWLAMBHAN)
fields.briefDescription: The SWAWLAMBHAN Scheme by the Govt. of Goa provides financial assistance to Mahila Mandals/Self-Help Groups for training/orientation for members of the Mahila Mandal/Self-Help Groups for generating their own activity for self-employment.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance in the Form of Grant-In-Aid to Bhajani/ Choir/ Cultural Group/ Institutions for Purchase of Musical Instruments
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme Provides Financial Assistance in the form of a Grant-In-Aid to Bhajani/ Choir/ Cultural Group/ Institutions for the Purchase of Musical Instruments. The Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art and Culture.

fields.schemeName: Agriculture And Processed Foods Export Promotion Scheme Of APEDA For The 15th Finance Commission Cycle (2021-22 To 2025-26)
fields.briefDescription: The Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS) is an export promotion scheme run by APEDA. The scheme aims to facilitate the export of agri-products by providing assistance to exporters.

fields.schemeName: 25% Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Union Territory of Lakshadweep has implemented the scheme “25% Capital Investment Subsidy” to provide financial assistance to local entrepreneurs for promoting Micro and small Enterprises in Lakshadweep.

fields.schemeName: Trademark Reimbursement Scheme
fields.briefDescription: “Trademark Reimbursement Scheme” is a part of the Start-up Policy 2017. For start-ups that have successfully entered the production/service delivery phase, and want to trademark their company name and logo, 50% of the cost of trade-mark registration of their company name and logo will be reimbursed.

fields.schemeName: R&D Reimbursement Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “R&D Reimbursement Scheme” is a part of the Start-up Policy 2017. The objective of the policy is to promote innovation amongst the Goans and local start-ups. 50% of R&D expenses, including salaries of PhD holders employed by start-ups, will be reimbursed for a period of two years.

fields.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Through the "Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme”, the projects which show immense promise and potential will be eligible for a grant of 30% of the loan interest amount, for the purpose of repayment of the interest component of a loan availed.
